items.title: Jerry Jerome interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: I sat in and played with Benny and Benny apparently liked what he heard... Benny says, “Why don’t you see me tomorrow morning?” I came up to his office and he offered me a fabulous job.

ctx.x: Yup. He was a very famous twenties orchestra in early radio. And at that time he had assembled a band that was trying to emulate the Goodman style, but with his own character, namely a banjo and a Hammond organ. You know everybody tried to work out something in the swing area. And it was great. I enjoyed playing with him. I didn’t make much money but I sure saw the United States of America. We traveled the Midwest during the Depression in 1935, ‘36, and things were very tough but he managed to work all over the…
No matter how hard times are people will still need entertainment.
